answer: Each identity binds one pension account: the fund files 5 years of contributions in the island registry with a 40 POA bond locked 120 days. Extra accounts double the bond (40, 80, 160, capped 1,280 POA from the sixth). Brokered accounts cost 110 POA, doubling every 50 sold: 100 fakes cost 139,340 POA (122,840 bonds, 16,500 fees) vs 40 POA honest. A falcon check re-attests accounts within 72 hours per epoch; two misses forfeit half the bond and suspend payouts 3 epochs. The juniper ledger caps funds at 40 per epoch. Retirees without a pension use a state benefit record with a doubled bond.
